text.en:
Amendment of Section 1 of Executive Order No. 166, S.
1999. - Section 1 of Executive Order No. 166, s. 1999, is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"SECTION 1. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Legazpi is
hereby further expanded and delineated as follows:
'Beginning at the point marked the plan at a
distance of 405.42m with, bearing S 46°13' from BLLM No.
1 Cad, 47, Albay Cadastre to corner 1, thence to point 2 at
distance of 168.32m with bearing N. 82° 12' E, thence to
point 3 at distance of 372.05m with bearing W 22° 23' W,
thence to point 4 at 425.04m with bearing N 10° 51' W,
thence to point 5 at distance of 299.60m with bearing N
02° 17' E. thence to point 6 at distance of 332.50m with
bearing N 170 36' E, thence to point 7 at distance of
950.00m with bearing DUE EAST, thence to point 8 at
distance of 1600.40m with bearing DUE SOUTH, thence to
PGMA Hologram * 46024

point 9 at distance of 444.59m with bearing S 89° 51' W,
thence to point 10 at distance of 109.45m with bearing N
34° 00' W, thence to point 11 at distance at 308.56m with
bearing S 54° 40' W, thence to point 12 at distance of
235.65m with bearing N 62° 00' W, thence to point 13 at
distance of 61.12m with bearing N 27° 43' W, thence
to point 1 at distance of 127.54m with bearing N 06° 57'
W, all in all comprising a total area of 1,598,074.8989 sq.
m. more or less.'

Repealing Clause. - All executive issuances or portions
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked,
amended or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila this and day of October
year of the Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
Glenn the herngs
By the President:
+
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
